skills.name: codebase-explore
skills.description: Use when gathering background codebase context as part of a larger workflow, such as the brainstorming or planning explore step, or before modifying unfamiliar code to understand architecture and structure. Not for a direct one-off question (use codebase-ask), a named symbol's callers/callees (use codebase-graph), the effect of a diff (use codebase-impact), capability mapping (use codebase-capabilities), or boundary/seam inspection (use codebase-seams).

skills.name: codebase-ask
skills.description: Use when the user asks a direct natural-language question about the codebase: 'where does X happen', 'how does X work', 'anything similar to X', 'what should I know before adding X'. Not for ambient context during brainstorming/planning (use codebase-explore), call graphs of a named symbol (use codebase-graph), what a diff affects (use codebase-impact), capability mapping (use codebase-capabilities), or boundary/seam inspection (use codebase-seams).

skills.name: codebase-index
skills.description: Use when the codebase index must be built, refreshed, or linked across repositories: 'index this repo', 'reindex', 'index is stale', 'link repos', or when other codebase skills report no index. This only builds or links the index; to answer questions use codebase-ask, codebase-graph, codebase-impact, codebase-capabilities, or codebase-seams.

skills.name: codebase-impact
skills.description: Use when the user asks what recent code changes affect: 'what did my changes break', 'blast radius of this diff', 'what might break', 'which tests are affected'. Works from a git diff or base SHA. Not for questions about code that has not changed (use codebase-ask) or one symbol's callers (use codebase-graph).

skills.name: codebase-graph
skills.description: Use when the user names a specific symbol and wants its relationships: 'who calls X', 'what does X call', 'call graph for X', 'dependencies of X'. Supports depth and direction. Not for general how/where questions (use codebase-ask) or diff-based impact (use codebase-impact).

skills.name: codebase-capabilities
skills.description: Use when the user wants to discover or inspect functional capabilities in one or more codebases: 'what capabilities exist', 'map capabilities', 'how is capability X structured', 'trace capability X across repos', 'compare capabilities between project A and B'. Not for a single symbol's immediate callers/callees (use codebase-graph) or boundary coupling inspection (use codebase-seams).

skills.name: codebase-seams
skills.description: Use when the user wants to identify, inspect, or audit architectural seams and boundaries within a codebase or across indexed repositories: 'what are the seams', 'find leaky seams', 'show the boundary between X and Y', 'where can we split or decouple X', 'how does repo A integrate with repo B'. Not for tracing a single symbol's call tree (use codebase-graph) or diff blast radius (use codebase-impact).

commands.name: codebase-ask
commands.description: Ask a question about the codebase. <question>

commands.name: codebase-index
commands.description: Build, refresh, or link the codebase index. [--mode full|moderate|fast|cross-repo-intelligence] [--link <project|*>]

commands.name: codebase-impact
commands.description: Show what your recent changes affect. [--base <sha>]

commands.name: codebase-graph
commands.description: Show a symbol's callers and callees. <symbol> [--depth 1-5] [--direction inbound|outbound|both]

commands.name: codebase-capabilities
commands.description: Map functional capabilities and execution corridors. [<capability>] [--project <name>...] [--depth 1-5]

commands.name: codebase-seams
commands.description: Inspect architectural seams and coupling across packages or repos. [<source> [<target>]] [--project <name>...]
